statement: Convert a closed mesh into a signed-distance volume at a chosen voxel size so it can be combined with boolean and offset operations.

statement: Create a volume around curves with a thickness, making tubes or curved bodies with smooth blends.
superiority: Dino 8 should produce variable-radius pipes with exact sweeps and avoid voxel artefacts.

acceptance.tolerance: distance field equals r - dist within 1 voxel

statement: Convert a point cloud into a volume by expanding each point by a radius to create a metaball-like body.
superiority: Dino 8 should support per-point radius and attributes with GPU accumulation.

acceptance.tolerance: union volume matches analytic union of spheres within 2 percent

statement: Combine volumes with robust boolean union, intersection and difference to create complex shapes.
superiority: Dino 8 should make booleans always succeed on volumes and offer exact B-rep results when requested.

statement: Grow or shrink a volume by a signed distance, tolerating self-intersections and thin parts.
superiority: Dino 8 should offer exact distance offsets with detail-preservation controls.

statement: Smooth a volume's surface to remove voxel irregularities before meshing.
superiority: Dino 8 should smooth with feature and volume preservation settings.

acceptance.tolerance: surface roughness RMS reduced by 70 percent; volume change under 1 percent

statement: Blend two volumes smoothly into a transition body to create organic joints.
